verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Management API reference page (supabase-docs-28) and a published OpenAPI spec (supabase-probe-3). Neither shows an interactive reference or runnable examples. A static reference plus a machine-readable spec are only adjacent building blocks: a user could load the spec into third-party tooling, but that is a user-side workaround, not the product's own interactive explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
